messages:
sam_cs: Heads up — LighthouseRx onboarding spike tomorrow. They asked for a temporary regional QPS bump + IP allowlist for their prod peering. @nora_ops can we expedite?

nora_ops: Can do. Need exact IP ranges and desired QPS. ETA for change?

sam_cs: Customer provided: 52.14.22.0/24, 52.14.23.12/32. Target bump from 50 -> 300 qps for ap-southeast-1 for the next 72h. They're doing a phased rollout. Also asked if we can pre-warm KV cache for common prefixes.

jiang_eng: @nora_ops I'll patch routing & rate-limiter rules and set auto-revoke at +72h. Will need a short change request in the ticket with expiry and justification. Example CLI I used in staging:
```bash
redwoodctl customers update --id lighthouse-rx --allowlist 52.14.22.0/24,52.14.23.12 --qps 300 --region ap-southeast-1 --revoke-in 72h
```

nora_ops: Thanks. I'll run that in staging then promote. Can someone drop the prod control-plane payload? I'll need it for the runbook.

sam_cs: Prod payload looks like this (sanitized):
```json
{
  "customer_id":"lighthouse-rx",
  "change":{
    "region":"ap-southeast-1",
    "qps":300,
    "allowlist":["52.14.22.0/24","52.14.23.12/32"],
    "auto_revoke":"72h"
  },
  "requested_by":"sam_cs"
}
```

sam_cs: Also, small commercial note — they're evaluating Dedicated after pilot; contract up in ~29 days. @emma_renewals can you do a soft touch and mention this bump as evidence of production readiness? Renewal risk is moderate if we don't keep momentum.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: change-request created (#CS-7892) by nora_ops - pending infra approval

jiang_eng: Applied staging rule, traffic pattern checks look good. Scheduling prod window in 12m at 10:00 UTC. Post-change checks: QPS, 5xx ratio, tail latency. Rollback criteria: 5xx > 1% or error spike > baseline + 0.5%.

nora_ops: Prod change executed at 10:03 UTC. CLI output (truncated):
```json
{"customer":"lighthouse-rx","region":"ap-southeast-1","qps":300,"allowlist":["52.14.22.0/24","52.14.23.12/32"],"revoke":"2026-04-02T10:03:00Z"}
```

sam_cs: :thumbsup: Customer confirms traffic is flowing, current 5xx ~= 0.2%, latency within SLO. I'll run the KV cache warmup script shortly.

emma_renewals: I'll email the account today, share the usage dashboard and propose a KPI-driven path to Dedicated (pilot -> committed). Ping me any extra numbers or demo clips.

sam_cs: Action items: 1) confirm auto-revoke runs (nora_ops), 2) send enablement doc + short KB for cache pre-warm (sam_cs), 3) renewal outreach (emma_renewals). Closing thread unless anything else pops up. Thanks team!
